<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<ValidationRule xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <fullName>Timeout_Range</fullName>
    <active>true</active>
    <description>Timeout must be between 1 and 120 seconds.</description>
    <errorConditionFormula>AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Timeout_Seconds__c)), OR(Timeout_Seconds__c < 1, Timeout_Seconds__c > 120))</errorConditionFormula>
    <errorMessage>Timeout must be between 1 and 120 seconds.</errorMessage>
</ValidationRule>
